title: CI/CD for AI Apps — Version Every Behavior Input
key_insight: Version code, prompts, settings, evaluation data, model or endpoint identifiers, and retrieval corpus. Attach those versions to deployment and traces.
body:
## Version Every Behavior Input

A production answer cannot be reproduced because nobody recorded the prompt template or provider model version.

Version code, prompts, settings, evaluation data, model or endpoint identifiers, and retrieval corpus. Attach those versions to deployment and traces.

Keep secrets and private evaluation data outside artifacts while recording secure references to their versions.
common_mistakes: Unit tests alone cover every AI behavior change.
Prompt versions need not be recorded.
Rollback always means changing only application code.
mini_exercise: Draw “Version Every Behavior Input” as three steps and explain each one.
real_world_usage: AI delivery pipelines test code, prompts, models, data contracts, and safety before controlled release.
explain_back_prompt: Use “Version Every Behavior Input” to explain CI/CD for AI Apps plainly.
